ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is predominantly low-intensity (dark) with sparse high-intensity (white) linear and circular markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous low-intensity black region. High-intensity white pixels are mapped as discrete linear streaks across both lobes and focal circular clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center; angle estimated at approximately 45 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with visible peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; notable jagged irregularities on the medial section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips of the fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (approximately 6-8) on the right lobe; dense high-intensity textured clusters corresponding to barnacle colonization at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle encrustation on distal tips; circular scars on right lobe surface; extensive white linear rake marks across the ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-relief textured protrusions at the extreme tips of the fluke caused by localized barnacle clusters.
